name: lib/list
description: Declares growable lists of borrowed byte pointers.
readme: Declares growable lists of borrowed byte pointers.
Import this module with use list.

files.content:
-- Declares growable lists of borrowed byte pointers.
public define List as opaque.
public use "list" function create giving failable pointer to List.
public use "list" function push(collection pointer to List, item pointer to byte) giving failable nothing.
public use "list" function get(collection pointer to List, index unsigned) giving failable pointer to byte.
public use "list" function length(collection pointer to List) giving failable unsigned.
public use "list" function close(collection pointer to List) giving failable nothing.
